verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents issuing shares to founders, investors and employees on its cap table (including preferred shares). It also offers built-in e-signing for equity agreements, which covers the in-platform signing part of the story. However, no evidence mentions electronic share certificates at all, let alone certificates permanently linked to their cap table entry. Missing for 10: explicit electronic share certificate issuance, evidence that certificates are e-signed in-platform, documented linkage between each certificate and its cap table entry, legal-validity details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
